I've implemented the version pinning support for registry templates. Here's a summary of the changes:

## `sdk/go/common/registry/resolve.go`
Added `ResolveTemplateFromName(ctx, reg, name, version)` — the template analog of the existing `ResolvePackageFromName`:
- **3-part** (`source/publisher/name`): calls `GetTemplate` directly with the version; returns `ErrNotFound` (checkable via `errors.Is`) when missing.
- **2-part** (`publisher/name`): tries `source="private"` first, falls back to `source="pulumi"` on `ErrNotFound`; wraps `ErrNotFound` if neither has it.
- **1-part** (`name`): uses `ListTemplates(ListTemplatesOptions{Name: name})` to discover source/publisher, then calls `GetTemplate` with the version if one was given. A versioned miss produces a message containing `version <X.Y.Z> was not found`.
- **4+ parts**: returns `InvalidIdentifierError` (detectable via `errors.As(err, &InvalidIdentifierError{})`).

## `pkg/cmd/pulumi/templates/cloud.go`
- Extracted URL parsing into a reusable `parseTemplateURL` helper (all four forms already parse `@version` via the existing `urls.go` code).
- `getRegistryTemplates` now detects a pinned version and routes to a new `getVersionedRegistryTemplate`, which resolves via `GetTemplate` (through `ResolveTemplateFromName`) rather than the latest-only `ListTemplates` path. On a not-found it produces `version 'X.Y.Z' not found` (single quotes); for VCS-backed results it errors with a message containing both `VCS-backed` and `does not support specific versions`.
- Removed the old `UnsupportedVersionError` gate that previously rejected concrete versions.

The existing `Registry` interface, `ListTemplatesOptions.Name`, `InvalidIdentifierError`, and `registryTemplate`'s `Name()`/`DisplayName()`/`Description()` already satisfied the remaining requirements.

I verified all requirement scenarios with temporary tests (since existing tests will be patched by the verification system), confirmed the existing test suites still pass, and both modules build/vet cleanly. I did not touch anything under `tests/`. A changelog entry was added.

Note: this change touches the public SDK surface (`sdk/go/common/registry`) and the CLI (`pkg/cmd/pulumi/templates`) — per the repo's escalation guidance, worth a maintainer's eye on the new exported `ResolveTemplateFromName` signature and the error-message wording.
